landing.problem.body: Attorneys must consult dozens of independent systems — federal, state, SCJN, Judiciary, regulations, DOF, procedural codes. Each source holds only part of what is needed to assess a matter.
landing.problem.title: Legal information in Mexico is fragmented.
landing.solution.body: Nyrava Intelligence unifies people, organizations, documents, evidence, witnesses, events, statutes, jurisprudencia and judicial decisions into a relational model — producing legal intelligence, not mere search results.
landing.solution.title: A connected legal knowledge environment.
landing.sources.title: Built for the Mexican legal framework.
